keyframe_review.note: New keyframe: Cliopatria has no Curaçao row; the Netherlands Antilles shape holds the island through 2023. Three grid cells (759 km2) for an island the infobox gives as 444 km2, ratio 1.7 (the cells include Klein Curaçao and coast).

ledger.note: 10 October 2010: Curaçao becomes a country within the Kingdom of the Netherlands. 'The dissolution of the Netherlands Antilles came into effect on 10 October 2010'; 'Curaçao became a country within the Kingdom of the Netherlands' with the Kingdom keeping defence and foreign policy (Curaçao page); 'The transition took place at midnight (00:00) ... 10/10/10' and Curaçao and Sint Maarten 'became two new landen' (Dissolution page). The Curaçao page dates the island under the Antilles from 1954 (as 'Island Territory of Curaçao') to 2010. The netherlands-antilles ledger 17 records the loss.

certainty.note: An island: the coast is the border (Klein Curaçao is part of the country).

notes: Written by n-mod from two pages. TYPE: colony of netherlands (constituent country, not sovereign); see aruba's notes. END 2026 = alive today; no dissolve. The Curaçao page does not mention a 2005 referendum (it gives a non-binding one on 15 May 2009 with 52 per cent in favour); the Dissolution page dates a Curaçao referendum favouring country status to 2005. Earlier history (Dutch capture 1634, British 1800-1803 and 1807-1815) is in netherlands-antilles ledger 0 and 5-9. The gazetteer's Curaçao country gives 3 cells.
